flight_routes AS (

    f.arrival_airport,
    -- Get coordinates for departure airport
    a1.longitude AS dep_long,
    a1.latitude AS dep_lat,
    -- Get coordinates for arrival airport
    a2.longitude AS arr_long,
    a2.latitude AS arr_lat,
    -- Check if Abakan is involved
    CASE 
      WHEN a1.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR a2.city LIKE '%Abakan%' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_abakan_route
  FROM airlines.flights f
  JOIN airport_coords a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
  JOIN airport_coords a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
  WHERE a1.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR a2.city LIKE '%Abakan%'

)
